Jobs Through Lifeline Placements in Chennai and Tamil Nadu

வேலை தேடுபவர்களுக்கு

Lifeline Placements fills roles for employers across Tamil Nadu: factory, warehouse, BPO, office, housekeeping, retail, hospital and hostel jobs. If you are looking for work, send your name, the job you want, your experience and your preferred area on WhatsApp. We contact you when a matching opening comes up.

WhatsApp your details

How do I apply for a job through Lifeline Placements?

Send a WhatsApp message to +91 99622 99076 with your name, the job you want, your education, your experience and the areas you can travel to. We match you against open requirements from employers. If there is a fit, we call you for a short screening before the employer interview.

Do I have to pay a fee?

[candidate fee policy: to confirm]

What should I keep ready?

  • A short CV, or details typed in WhatsApp
  • Identity and address proof (show at joining; do not send copies until an employer selects you)
  • Education or ITI certificates for skilled roles
  • Bank account details for salary (only after selection)

Your data

We use your details only to match you with jobs and to contact you. Read our privacy notice before sending documents. To have your details deleted, message "DELETE MY DATA" on WhatsApp.
